sloka: लोभात् पापानि कुर्वाणः कामात् वा यो न बुध्यते ।हृष्टः पश्यति तस्य अन्तम् ब्राह्मणी करकात् इव ॥३-२९-५॥
transliteration: lobhāt pāpāni kurvāṇaḥ kāmāt vā yo na budhyate ।hṛṣṭaḥ paśyati tasya antam brāhmaṇī karakāt iva ॥3-29-5॥

translations.english: Whoever commits sinful deeds out of greed or passion and without realisation will be ruined at the end like a lizard that eats hailstone (and dies).
